project.name: IcarusCasework
project.purpose: Reconstruct heterogeneous case material into a source-linked operational record that separates claims, evidence, chronology, and uncertainty.
project.product_boundary: Public-record case reconstruction workspace for true-crime and long-form case research first; not a verdict, diagnosis, admissibility, or law-enforcement decision engine.

v1_proof_obligation: Given a bounded corpus of public or authorized case materials, Icarus Casework can produce a reproducible, source-linked longitudinal reconstruction that separates reported claims from supported events, preserves contradictions and source lineage, shows cumulative change over time, and tests the conditions required by competing accounts.
invariants: Every consequential claim must remain attributable to source.
Repeated reporting does not equal independent corroboration.
Evidence and claims must remain distinct.
Unknowns and unresolved intervals must remain explicit.
Narrative output must not silently collapse uncertainty.
control_boundaries: No guilt or innocence scoring in v1.
No private medical-record collection in v1.
Do not let probabilistic tooling redefine the authoritative evidence graph.
source_types: medical records when public and lawful
human_decisions: Whether SystemNode is canonical or role-based in the persisted schema
known_decisions: Casework has its own repo boundary.
ONTOLOGY.md will be a stable root operating file after kickoff.
Casework should be constrained by Five Core Primitives before scaffolding.
The build must not infer a product contract directly from a research pile.
SourceArtifact is the immutable evidence object.
Document is a format/type classification of SourceArtifact.
Source is provenance context, not a catch-all object.
Claim is a first-class evidentiary assertion.
Probabilistic output is always a Projection.
True-crime/public-record research is the approved first wedge.
open_questions: Exact persisted schema for source, claim, event, and lineage structures
Whether SystemNode is modeled as a canonical entity or role wrapper
Exact representation of event time vs report time
rejected_scope: full unbounded monorepo for all future Icarus products
required_tests: two competing accounts tested against explicit conditions
first_build_slice: Ingest one source artifact -> preserve the original -> extract one attributed claim with an exact citation -> review it -> represent one supported event -> display both on a source-linked timeline.
